 The Tampa Bay Lightning (12-4-2) and Columbus Blue Jackets (7-9-0) will meet in the NHL tonight. Puck drop is set for 7:00 p.m. EST at Nationwide Arena in Columbus, Ohio. The game will broadcast live on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Lightning are favored at -114 on the moneyline, with the Blue Jackets at -105 to pull off the upset. The over/under is set at 6.5 (-105o / -115u).
 Let's get into our Lightning vs. Blue Jackets predictions and NHL picks .
 Lightning vs. Blue Jackets Prediction
 Pick: Lightning ML (-114) 
 Our Tampa Bay vs. Columbus best bet is on the Lightning to win outright, with the best odds currently available at FanDuel . For all of your NHL bets, be sure to find the best lines by using our live NHL odds page. 
 Make sure to download the Action Network app for more NHL picks and analysis! 
 Lightning vs Blue Jackets Odds
 Lightning vs. Blue Jackets puck line: Lightning -1.5 (+205), Blue Jackets +1.5 (-260)
 Lightning vs. Blue Jackets over/under: 6.5 (-105o / -115u)
 Lightning vs. Blue Jackets moneyline: Lightning -114, Blue Jackets -105
 Lightning vs. Blue Jackets best bet: Lightning ML (-114) 
 Tonight's matchup presents a textbook setup for our Bet Labs "Road Fav, Conf Mid Dog" system, pointing squarely to Tampa Bay on the moneyline at -114.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement This strategy isolates regular-season conference matchups with high expected scoring (totals of 6 or higher), capitalizing on public bias that frequently undervalues superior teams simply because they are playing away from home.
 With the over/under set at 6.5 and the Lightning laying a short -114 price, oddsmakers are anticipating an up-tempo game while giving the Blue Jackets significant home-ice respect, creating an ideal buying opportunity on the road favorite.
 When comparing the underlying metrics of these two Eastern Conference foes, the disparity in overall quality becomes immediately apparent. Tampa Bay enters Thursday night sitting second in the Atlantic Division at 12-4-2 (26 points), boasting the NHL's fourth-most prolific offense with 71 goals scored (3.94 per game) alongside a Simple Rating System (SRS) mark of 0.75, good for sixth in the league.
 Conversely, Columbus sits in the cellar of the Metropolitan Division at 7-9-0 (14 points) with a -0.50 SRS (24th). While the Blue Jackets have kept games competitive thanks to a respectable defensive mark (51 goals against, 7th in the league), their offense has been practically nonexistent, ranking 31st out of 32 teams with just 39 goals (2.44 per game).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The system's emphasis on higher-total environments directly exploits Columbus's inability to keep pace in a track meet against elite offensive firepower.
 Tampa Bay's top-six forward group is firing on all cylinders, spearheaded by Nikita Kucherov (26 points; 8 goals, 18 assists), Jake Guentzel (22 points; 10 goals, 12 assists), and Brandon Hagel (21 points; 11 goals, 10 assists).
 That star-studded trio alone has nearly matched the entire Blue Jackets roster in goal production, and Tampa Bay arrives in Ohio fresh off an explosive 8-3 road demolition of the Buffalo Sabres on Wednesday night.
 For a Columbus squad led in scoring by Kent Johnson (16 points) that has been held to two goals or fewer in six of its last eight outings—including a 4-1 home loss to Florida on Tuesday—matching Tampa Bay's offensive ceiling in a game projected to reach 6.5 goals is a tall order.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Ultimately, the market is offering a discounted -114 moneyline on a Stanley Cup contender (+1300 preseason odds) largely due to situational optics: Tampa Bay is playing the second leg of a road back-to-back, whereas Columbus has been decent at Nationwide Arena (6-4-0). However, this exact dynamic is what our system is designed to target.
 Rather than overreacting to travel fatigue or home-ice splits, the system trusts the far superior roster to dictate the pace in a high-total conference spot.
 Backing the Lightning at -114 allows bettors to avoid laying the 1.5 goals on the puck line while capturing massive value on a top-tier offense against a struggling division rival.
 Best Bet: Lightning ML (-114, FanDuel )
